# Rendering & Visualization Requirements Quality Checklist: Soil Health Visualization

**Purpose**: Validate the quality, completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of rendering and visualization requirements for the Soil Health Visualization feature. This checklist tests the REQUIREMENTS themselves — not the implementation.
**Created**: 2026-09-12
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Overlay Rendering Requirements

- [x] CHK001 Are the exact alpha transparency values for tile overlays quantified, and is the "~0.3" approximation in FR-023 resolved to a specific constant or range? [Clarity, Spec §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the viewport culling margin (1-tile beyond visible bounds) consistently specified between FR-018 and the viewport culling description in FR-009, and does the requirement explicitly state whether the margin applies to all four edges? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, §FR-018] — REVIEW: FR-018 doesn't state the margin applies to all four edges (research.md §5 shows X-axis only), and FR-009's "only tiles visible in the current viewport" vs the 1-tile margin is unreconciled.
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements defined for overlay rendering when a tile is partially off-screen at viewport edges — specifically, is the clipping behavior (full overlay vs. clipped overlay) specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the rendering order between overlays, characters, and world layers explicitly defined beyond "above world and characters" — does the spec address z-ordering when multiple mod overlays are present? [Clarity, Gap] — REVIEW: No requirement addresses draw order vs other mods' overlays in Display.RenderedWorld (SMAPI handler order is undefined across mods).
- [x] CHK005 Are requirements specified for overlay rendering when the player's viewport is at the extreme edge of the map (e.g., map boundary tiles where the 1-tile margin would extend beyond map bounds)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-018]

## Color Interpolation Requirements

- [x] CHK006 Are the half-open interval boundaries ([0, 34), [34, 67), [67, 100]) consistently defined between FR-008, the ColorMapping entity, and the HealthCategory entity, and is the interpolation divisor (33 vs. 34) explicitly resolved? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, data-model.md §ColorMapping, §HealthCategory]
- [x] CHK007 Is the interpolation behavior at exact boundary values (33.5, 66.5) specified for non-integer health values, or is the spec ambiguous about whether health values are always integers? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK008 Are requirements defined for color interpolation when custom colors are configured by the user — does the interpolation algorithm remain identical regardless of custom color values, or are edge cases (e.g., identical custom colors) addressed? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008, Gap]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the RGB interpolation formula explicitly documented in the requirements (e.g., `result = colorA + (colorB - colorA) * t`), or is the implementation expected to discover this from research notes alone? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, research.md §2] — REVIEW: Formula and t normalization exist only in research.md §2; spec.md says only "linear interpolation in RGB space" without the formula.

## Accessibility Pattern Requirements

- [x] CHK010 Are the minimum pattern visibility constraints (stripes ≥4px wide, dots ≥4px diameter with ≥4px spacing) sufficient to guarantee visibility at all zoom levels supported by Stardew Valley, or should additional zoom-level constraints be specified? [Measurability, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK011 Is the pattern opacity floor (minimum 0.7) explicitly required to be independent of the user-configured overlay opacity, and is this relationship clearly stated in FR-001? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK012 Are requirements defined for pattern rendering when the overlay opacity is set below 0.7 — does the pattern opacity remain at 0.7 while the base overlay uses the lower configured value? [Coverage, Spec §FR-001, Gap]
- [x] CHK013 Is the WCAG 1.4.11 3:1 non-text contrast ratio requirement for moderate yellow and healthy green against white patterns specified as a requirement that must be verified, or is it deferred to implementation? [Measurability, Spec §FR-001] — RESOLVED (clarify 2026-09-13): earth-tone defaults canonical — #D97706 and #15803D verify at 3.19:1 and 5.02:1 against white patterns; the 3:1 MUST is retained in FR-001
- [x] CHK014 Are requirements defined for the pattern texture dimensions (16x16 pixels mentioned in data-model) — is this a requirement or an implementation detail, and should the spec specify minimum texture resolution? [Clarity, Gap, data-model.md §PatternType]

## Performance Requirements

- [ ] CHK015 Is the 60 FPS target quantified with an explicit per-frame time budget (16.67ms) for the visualization system alone, and does the spec define what portion of the frame budget visualization is allowed to consume? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002] — REVIEW: 16.67ms is defined only as the whole-frame budget; no portion/sub-budget for the visualization system itself.
- [x] CHK016 Is the degradation threshold (>1,000 visible tilled tiles) explicitly defined as a strict greater-than comparison, and is the behavior at exactly 1,000 tiles unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK017 Are requirements defined for the performance degradation behavior when the visible tile count oscillates rapidly around the 1,000 threshold (e.g., 999→1001→999 within a few frames)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009, Clarifications Session 2026-09-10]
- [x] CHK018 Is the degradation notification frequency specified for the `notify` mode — does it fire once per degradation event (same as auto mode) or on every frame above threshold? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, Clarifications Session 2026-09-10]
- [x] CHK019 Are SpriteBatch batching requirements explicitly stated (single Begin/End pair for all overlays), or is this an implementation detail left to the developer? [Completeness, Gap, research.md §9]

## Rendering Event Requirements

- [x] CHK020 Is the distinction between Display.RenderedWorld (overlays) and Display.Rendered (tooltips/floating text) consistently applied across all visualization features, and is there any feature that ambiguously belongs to neither event? [Consistency, Spec §FR-023, §FR-024] — RESOLVED (clarify 2026-09-13): hoe flash assigned to Display.RenderedWorld (FR-003/FR-023); floating text remains in Display.Rendered (FR-024)
- [x] CHK021 Are requirements defined for rendering event behavior when the game is running at a frame rate lower than 60 FPS — do tooltips and floating text still render correctly in Display.Rendered? [Coverage, Gap]
- [x] CHK022 Is the rendering event subscription lifecycle (subscribe on GameLaunched, unsubscribe on disposal) explicitly required for all visualization components, or only for the top-level service? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]

## Edge Case Requirements

- [x] CHK023 Are requirements defined for overlay rendering when a location has zero tilled soil tiles — does the spec explicitly state that no rendering occurs and minimal resources are used? [Coverage, Spec §FR-021]
- [x] CHK024 Is the behavior specified when the player warps to a new location that has no soil health data at all — does the system render gray overlays for all tilled tiles, or render nothing until data is queried? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010, Clarifications Session 2026-09-10]
- [x] CHK025 Are requirements defined for rendering when the soil health data becomes available mid-frame (e.g., async load completes during Display.RenderedWorld) — does the system defer to the next frame per FR-020? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014, §FR-020]
